processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: A 20 kg ingot of a Fe–10Mn–10Al–0.7C steel was prepared by vacuum induction melting method.
The ingot was heated to 1200 °C and then forged to forging blank with cross section of about 40 mm × 60 mm.
The forging blank was hot-rolled to the plate of 3 mm thickness, with the finishing rolling temperature around 880 °C.
Water quenched to about 300 °C then air cooled (Fig. 1).
Annealed at 900 °C for 1 h; at this temperature κ-carbide has almost fully dissolved (only a small amount of boundary κ forms during quenching).
Followed by water quenching (final step of the thermo-mechanical schedule, Fig. 1).
